correlation_overlap_vs_registry.reading: Both gate trips are dense rasters (5.1 M and 0.2 M positive cells). Reverse overlap is about 19%. Jaccard is below 0.01. The literal 70% rule fails on density, not on a copied dot set.

decision_rule.note: A promote verdict here would still NOT clear a weekly slot; a separate selector step is required.
promote_requires: candidate pooled DTI > matched-random-null pooled DTI (mean of 3 seeds)
paired per-cell bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of (candidate - null) > 0
leakage canary: every single feature's per-cell direction-invariant AUC < 0.90
shared validator passes on the zeros-outside primary
literal registry gate: surface Spearman <= 0.90 AND final-dot 3 px overlap <= 0.70 vs every local TIF

hypothesis: H-R1: potassic alteration (block-normalised K high, Th low) that coincides with a horizontal total-magnetic-intensity gradient maximum marks a fault-controlled fluid pathway, so it can locate mapped and unmapped structure beneath cover.
mechanism: Hydrothermal potassic alteration of fault-controlled permeable zones raises K relative to Th, and the same structures produce a magnetic gradient. Co-location of the two is the proposed signature.
named_non_fault_mimic: K-rich granite and pluton margins (lithologic contacts); alluvial and playa K variation; acquisition-block seams in the GeoDAWN radiometrics (block z-scores reduce them but do not remove them).
